replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body: I love it! I do not think it needs more details, maps like these are meant to be flat, simple, and symmetrical. One suggestion, though, is that you should make the platforms a little wider, because people would get knocked off easily, and the gameplay would be like fighting on a bridge all the time. I could imagine myself rushing on the wall though
